articles.summary: Interpreting data from dashboards and charts always comes with a risk: congitive biases affecting our focus and the decisions taken. In traditional BI pipelines, these biases risk to be amplified, as an individual analyst decides what to show and what not to show, constraining the thinking and data exploration process
articles.title: Cognitive Biases in Business Intelligence
